title: Interview opening and setup
summary: Allen and Russell introduce the date, place and interviewee and set up the microphone.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Okay, we're interviewing today at 1722 New Orleans Street, that's right. Let's see, what's today's date, folks? 22nd. June the 22nd, 1960. And who are we interviewing? What's that mean? Lewis Bobrin. That's your full name? Lewis Isidall Bobrin.
Same as your father's name. My father's name, I think.
Your father's name was Isidall. Yeah, that's right. Don't know.

I'm going to put the microphone right here and hopefully it doesn't pick up too much of the fan noise. You all need a fan? Don't cut it out. Maybe we can cut it out. I'll take it off. Cut it out. Pick up. Yeah. Pick up that squeak in there.

Okay, I'll put my name. Dick Allen. Bill? This is Bill Russell. Ralph Collins. Okay. All right. I think that's a good introduction there. Everybody knows which voice it is on the tape when they hear it.

Do you want to start out when you were born? Just anything you have your notes there if you want to follow that would be fine. You want to, when you're ready? Yeah. I learned how to play the drums. Right?
Everything we've done since we've done. Yeah, we'd like to get your birthday next time. You all ready now?
Mm-hmm. It's on? It's on. Yeah.
